svg.title: SolvAI: reusable solvent information from distinct sources

g.text: The cost of a new solvent calculation
A new physical calculation is costly
when it must be repeated for every query.
SolvAI learns from existing solvent information.
Six source datasets teach reusable response maps
Different targets; one common molecular input
Freeze six model groups → 15 predicted response coordinates
Inference: SMILES only; no new solvent simulation or measurement.
Evaluation separates endpoint and source exposure
